name: claude-skill-deployer
description: Detect project stack and deploy AI agent skills (Claude, Cursor, Kiro, Copilot) with budget controls, branch profiles, and usage reports.

commands.title: Apply Suggested Skills for Current Task
Export Team Branch Profile to Git
Apply Team Branch Profile from Git
Enable Cost Control Hooks (Budget + Session + Focus)
Cycle Context Focus Level (Knowledge / Balanced / Local / Strict)
Choose Project Profile Tier (Compare Plans & Savings)
Save Skill Set for Current IDE
Install Skill Library to All Enabled AI Agents
Sync Workspace Skills to All Agents

claudeSkills.revealOutputPanel.description: When true, extension commands open the Claude Skills output panel after writing logs. When false (default), logs are written silently so the terminal stays focused.

enumDescriptions: No toasts — errors and confirmations only. Work is logged to the output channel.
Quiet default — background auto-apply and suggestions log only; command success uses output/status bar.
All notifications — previous behavior including auto-apply and suggestion toasts.
claudeSkills.notificationLevel.description: How chatty the extension is with VS Code notification toasts.

claudeSkills.autoUpdateExtension.description: Silently check Open VSX for a newer extension release and install it in the background (production installs only).

claudeSkills.autoUpdateExtensionHours.description: Hours between background extension update checks.

claudeSkills.officialSkillsCheckOnSessio.description: When skills_library/ exists, install a Claude Code SessionStart hook that checks anthropics/skills for updates and prompts skill-official-updater.

claudeSkills.preferLocalSkillOverrides.description: When unchecking a skill committed on the current branch, disable it locally via .claude/settings.local.json instead of deleting .claude/skills/ (no git diff).

claudeSkills.budget.autoDisableHighTier.description: When the daily budget is exceeded, auto-disable high-tier skills locally via skillOverrides.

claudeSkills.budget.dailyBudgetUsd.description: Daily estimated spend cap in USD (0 disables the cap). Uses transcript-based estimates, not an actual bill.

claudeSkills.budget.economyWarnUsd.description: In economy mode, warn once per day when today's estimated spend crosses this USD amount.

enumDescriptions: Disable high-tier skills locally and warn at low spend thresholds.
Warn at 80% of daily budget; auto-disable high-tier skills when budget is exceeded.
No restrictions; notify once per day at a high spend threshold.
claudeSkills.budget.mode.description: Token budget mode across all Claude Code projects on this machine.

claudeSkills.budget.unlimitedNotifyUsd.description: In unlimited mode, notify once per day when today's estimated spend crosses this USD amount.

claudeSkills.budget.warnThresholdPercent.description: Warn when today's estimated spend reaches this percentage of the daily budget.

claudeSkills.skillFeedback.promptOnHighU.description: When a git branch or active task exceeds the monthly credit threshold, show a notification offering to install suggested skills from task-skill-proposals.json.

claudeSkills.skillFeedback.monthlyCredit.description: Prompt when branch/task spend reaches this percentage of the monthly credit budget.
Monthly credit budget in USD for threshold checks. 0 = use daily budget × 30, or 30-day workspace spend if daily budget is off.

claudeSkills.contextFocus.enabled.description: Inject grounding instructions via the context-focus hook to balance local workspace context vs general LLM knowledge.

enumDescriptions: Prefer general LLM knowledge; read workspace files when editing or when asked about this repo.
Verify repo-specific facts in files; use general knowledge for concepts (recommended default).
Read and cite workspace files before claiming how this project works; load only task-relevant skills.
Only assert facts from read files, user input, or tool output — say uncertain rather than guess.
claudeSkills.contextFocus.level.description: How strongly to prioritize verified local workspace context over general model knowledge.

claudeSkills.contextFocus.autoEscalateOn.description: When the session transcript grows large, automatically tighten context focus (warn: one step stricter; critical: strict-local).

claudeSkills.contextFocus.injectEveryPro.description: Inject grounding on every prompt. When false, inject once per session plus whenever the session is large.

claudeSkills.contextFocus.limitSkillCata.description: When many skills are installed and focus is local-first or strict-local, remind the agent to load only task-relevant skills.

claudeSkills.contextFocus.manySkillsThre.description: Installed skill count at which catalog-limit hints apply.

claudeSkills.costIntelligence.lowTrustPr.description: On new agent sessions, silently inject context when cost attribution trust score is below the threshold (hooks read .claude/learning/attribution-trust.json).
Inject low-trust prompt when workspace attribution confidence is below this percent (0–100).

claudeSkills.practicalFocus.enabled.description: Inject deployment-first guidance via hook — concrete architecture and first-try deploy steps instead of theoretical advice.

enumDescriptions: Trade-offs and theory are fine — early design discussions.
Mix theory with concrete next steps tied to this repo.
Concrete architecture and IaC aligned with repo patterns; read infra before advising (recommended when enabling).
Every answer must be first-try deployable: exact commands, prereqs, validation, rollback.
claudeSkills.practicalFocus.level.description: How strongly to favor provisionable architecture over hand-wavy theoretical recommendations.

claudeSkills.practicalFocus.injectEveryP.description: Inject on every prompt. When false, inject once per session.

claudeSkills.practicalFocus.recommendDep.description: At architecture-first and deploy-ready, remind the agent to read the deployment-practical skill.

claudeSkills.practicalFocus.requireValid.description: At deploy-ready, require validation commands before marking deployment tasks complete.

claudeSkills.branchProfiles.autoApplyOnS.description: When switching git branches, install skills from the saved profile for the new branch.

claudeSkills.branchProfiles.removeExtraO.description: When applying a branch profile, remove personal-only skills (not on the branch) that are not in the profile. Branch-committed skills are disabled via skillOverrides instead of deleted.

claudeSkills.branchProfiles.teamProfileP.description: Git-committed team skill layout per branch (export with Export Team Branch Profile to Git).

claudeSkills.agentProfiles.enabled.description: Store separate skill layouts per IDE/agent (Cursor, Kiro, VS Code/Copilot, Claude Code) per git branch in ~/.claude/learning/agent-skill-profiles.json. Requires claudeSkills.features.multiAgent.

claudeSkills.agentProfiles.autoApplyOnAc.description: When opening a workspace, apply the saved skill set for the current IDE (detected from the editor) and git branch.

claudeSkills.agentProfiles.saveOnBranchP.description: When the branch skill profile is saved (skill checkbox changes), also update the saved set for the current IDE.

claudeSkills.agentProfiles.vscodeAgent.description: When running in plain VS Code (not Cursor/Kiro), which agent id to use for IDE skill sets.

claudeSkills.agentProfiles.hostAgentOver.description: Optional: force which agent/IDE profile is active instead of auto-detecting from the editor name.

claudeSkills.projectProfile.autoDetect.description: On workspace open, detect solo/team/budget/throwaway scenario and write .claude/learning/project-profile.json.

claudeSkills.projectProfile.applyTierFea.description: When on, tier presets override claudeSkills.features.* for this workspace (reduces CPU/tokens for solo and throwaway projects). VS Code settings still apply when a tier leaves a feature unspecified.

claudeSkills.projectProfile.promptOnFirs.description: On first workspace open (no project-profile.json yet), ask how you plan to use AI agents — e.g. multi-agent team vs solo — instead of silently applying auto-detect.

claudeSkills.projectProfile.probeRemoteG.description: When choosing a project tier, probe origin via git ls-remote (extension-only, no AI agent) for branch/author signals. Cached 1h in .claude/learning/remote-repo-probe.json.

claudeSkills.projectProfile.remoteProbeT.description: Timeout for git ls-remote when probing origin during tier selection.

claudeSkills.projectProfile.lockedTier.description: Lock a project profile tier (workspace). Empty = auto-detect. Use command 'Choose Project Profile Tier' to set.

claudeSkills.profileInit.enabled.description: Role-based skill profile init: agent picks skills from the live catalog per branch (stored locally, not committed).

claudeSkills.profileInit.promptOnNewBran.description: When switching to a git branch with no saved skill profile, prompt to run profile init.

claudeSkills.profileInit.autoApplyProfil.description: When the agent writes .claude/profile.local.json, automatically install the selected skills.

claudeSkills.profileInit.deterministicAp.description: Pick branch skills from role + workspace heuristics in the extension (no agent session). Writes profile.local.json and applies locally.

claudeSkills.profileInit.autoStartOnSess.description: Install session hooks (Claude SessionStart, Cursor sessionStart, Kiro agentSpawn, Copilot SessionStart) and sync profile-init to all agents when a branch profile request is pending.

claudeSkills.profileInit.requiredSkills.description: Platform skills always merged into every profile-init skill set (learning, usage KPIs, feedback, skill authoring, official sync).

claudeSkills.profileInit.recoverRequired.description: When switching to a git branch with no saved skill profile (or on first open when required skills are missing), reinstall required platform skills from the library if they were deleted or locally disabled.

claudeSkills.lifecycle.alertOnOutdated.description: Detect installed skills whose catalog version is newer than the workspace copy.

claudeSkills.lifecycle.autoSuggestUpgrad.description: Periodically prompt to upgrade outdated skills from the bundled library.

claudeSkills.agents.enabled.description: AI agents that receive skill clones from this library (see skills_library/agents.json). Includes copilot (.github/instructions).

claudeSkills.agents.syncGlobalToAll.description: When installing the global library, sync to all enabled agents instead of Claude only. Requires claudeSkills.features.multiAgent.

claudeSkills.agents.syncHooksOnSkillChan.description: When workspace skills change, refresh hook scripts in .claude/hooks/ (cost-control hooks only if already enabled). Attribution v2 hooks are controlled by autoInstallAttributionHooks.

claudeSkills.agents.autoInstallAttributi.description: Automatically install Attribution v2 hooks (PostToolUse/postToolUse Skill invoke logging) for Claude, Cursor, Kiro, and Copilot when the extension activates or workspace skills change.

claudeSkills.agents.syncWorkspaceToAll.description: When installing workspace skills, deploy to all enabled agent paths (.claude, .cursor, .kiro, .github/instructions). Requires claudeSkills.features.multiAgent.

claudeSkills.features.autoOptimizer.description: Enable the auto-optimizer timer (off by default; turn on only after attribution looks reliable).

claudeSkills.features.budgetControls.description: Daily budget, economy mode, and cost control hooks.

claudeSkills.features.costAwareSearch.description: Show ROI/cost in skills tree and enable cost-based sorting.

claudeSkills.features.skillSetResolver.description: Enable the weekly skill set resolver scheduler (also requires claudeSkills.skillSetResolver.enabled).

claudeSkills.features.sessionSkillAdapta.description: On each new AI agent session or window, install and locally enable the proposed skill set from the branch profile and task-skill-proposals.json (Claude SessionStart, Cursor sessionStart, Kiro agentSpawn, Copilot SessionStart hooks). Toggle via Claude Skills: Manage Feature Toggles.

claudeSkills.features.autoApplyTaskPropo.description: Auto-install and locally enable every skill in Proposed for current task (task-skill-proposals.json), plus required platform skills, for this workspace only. Requires sessionSkillAdaptation.

claudeSkills.features.deterministicTaskP.description: Extension refreshes task-skill-proposals.json from workspace heuristics and skips agent regeneration on new sessions when proposals are fresh (<24h).

claudeSkills.features.taskSkillFocus.description: After auto-apply, disable (skillOverrides off) installed skills outside the task proposal set so agents only see the focused skill list. Re-enable via Skills tree checkbox.

claudeSkills.features.contextFocus.description: Context focus level toggle and grounding hook to reduce hallucination in long sessions.

claudeSkills.features.practicalFocus.description: Practical/deployment focus toggle — architecture and first-try deploy steps over theoretical advice.

claudeSkills.features.costIntelligence.description: Cost dashboard, optimization suggestions, and reports.

claudeSkills.features.emergencyCutoff.description: Hard daily spend cutoff that disables all workspace skills.

claudeSkills.features.multiAgent.description: Deploy skills to Cursor, Kiro, and Copilot.

claudeSkills.features.prCostEstimate.description: GitHub PR cost estimate via gh CLI.

claudeSkills.features.predictiveAlerts.description: Weekly trend warnings when spend is projected over budget.

claudeSkills.features.teamCostSharing.description: Attribute skill cost to git authors in shared .claude/skills/.

claudeSkills.lint.blockSyncOnError.description: Block multi-agent sync when SKILL.md lint reports errors.

claudeSkills.lint.enabled.description: Lint SKILL.md frontmatter (name, description, size) on workspace skill sync.

claudeSkills.lint.maxDescriptionLength.description: Warn when frontmatter description exceeds this length.

claudeSkills.lint.maxSkillBytes.description: Warn when SKILL.md exceeds this size (bytes).

claudeSkills.optimizer.agentSavingsRatio.description: Suggest agent switch when alternate agent cost is below this fraction of Claude cost.

claudeSkills.optimizer.autoApply.description: Automatically disable expensive rarely-used skills and apply safe optimizations (disable/unused only, max 3 per 30 min).

claudeSkills.optimizer.autoDetectOnPipel.description: When autoApply is on, run detect → auto-adjust after each cost pipeline sync (debounced ~5s), not only on the 30-minute timer.

claudeSkills.optimizer.disableCostPerUse.description: Suggest disabling a skill when attributed cost per use exceeds this (USD).

claudeSkills.optimizer.disableMaxRuns.description: Pair with disableCostPerUseUsd — only suggest disable when runs are below this count.

claudeSkills.optimizer.unusedIdleDays.description: Suggest disabling skills with no usage for at least this many days.

claudeSkills.optimizer.unusedMinCostUsd.description: Minimum attributed cost before idle-day unused suggestions appear.

claudeSkills.optimizer.weeklyBudgetUsd.description: Weekly spend cap for predictive alerts (0 = daily budget x 7).

claudeSkills.archival.autoArchive.description: Automatically archive qualifying skills (moves to skills-archived, not deleted).

claudeSkills.archival.costPerUse.description: Archive if cost per use exceeds this USD and idle 14+ days.

claudeSkills.archival.noUsageDays.description: Archive skills unused for this many days (when auto-archive enabled).

claudeSkills.emergency.hardLimitUsd.description: Absolute daily spend limit that triggers emergency cutoff.

claudeSkills.emergency.perSkillLimitUsd.description: When cutoff triggers, disable only skills with attributed cost at or above this threshold (restores prior overrides on reset).

claudeSkills.benchmarks.downloadUrl.description: Optional HTTPS endpoint to download community benchmarks weekly.

claudeSkills.benchmarks.optIn.description: Opt in to anonymized benchmark upload.

claudeSkills.benchmarks.uploadUrl.description: Optional HTTPS endpoint for anonymized benchmark upload.

claudeSkills.telemetry.enabled.description: Send anonymous local health metrics (activation counts, feature usage) to ~/.claude/learning/health-metrics.json only — no network upload unless you add your own exporter.

claudeSkills.weeklyReport.emailSubject.description: Email subject prefix. Body includes extension benefits from runs.jsonl and project-profile.json plus AI spend.

claudeSkills.weeklyReport.emailTo.description: Override email recipient. Empty = discovered via Configure Weekly Report Email (GitHub/GitLab token).

claudeSkills.weeklyReport.enabled.description: Send a weekly AI agent usage report (off until you run Configure Weekly Report Email; requires VS Code open at scheduled time).

claudeSkills.weeklyReport.hour.description: Local hour to send the weekly report.

claudeSkills.weeklyReport.minute.description: Local minute to send the weekly report.

claudeSkills.weeklyReport.smtpHost.description: SMTP host for direct email (or set CLAUDE_SKILLS_SMTP_HOST).

claudeSkills.weeklyReport.smtpPassword.description: SMTP password (or CLAUDE_SKILLS_SMTP_PASSWORD). Prefer env vars over storing secrets in settings.

claudeSkills.skillSetResolver.enabled.description: Once per week, install skills that match this workspace and remove library skills that no longer match detect_globs (requires VS Code open at scheduled time).

claudeSkills.skillSetResolver.hour.description: Local hour to run the weekly skill set resolver.

claudeSkills.skillSetResolver.minute.description: Local minute to run the weekly skill set resolver.

claudeSkills.skillSetResolver.installRel.description: Install library skills whose detect_globs match files in this workspace.

claudeSkills.skillSetResolver.removeIrre.description: Remove installed library skills that no longer match this workspace (never removes project-local skills).

claudeSkills.skillSetResolver.keepActive.description: Keep skills with active usage (2+ runs in the last 30 days) even when detect_globs no longer match.

claudeSkills.skillSetResolver.usageRules.description: Apply usage/session/token/cost rules when resolving the skill set (works with the weekly scheduler).
Remove installed library skills with zero recorded sessions in runs.jsonl.
When removeNeverUsed is on, also remove unused skills that still match detect_globs (reduces skill catalog token load).
Remove skills idle for at least unusedIdleDays with attributed cost ≥ minAttributedCostUsd.
Days since last use before idle removal applies.
Minimum attributed cost (USD) before idle or cost-based removal.
Remove low-usage skills idle for at least lowUsageIdleDays.
Days since last use before stale low-usage removal.
Remove skills with fewer than minSessionsToKeep recorded sessions.
Keep skills with at least this many runs.jsonl sessions (when removeBySessions is on).
Remove skills whose total recorded tokens fall below minTotalTokensToKeep.
Minimum runs.jsonl token total to keep a skill (when removeByTokens is on).
Remove expensive low-use skills when attributed cost per session exceeds maxCostPerUseUsd.
Max attributed USD per session before cost-based removal (paired with maxRunsForCostRemoval).
Only cost-remove skills with at most this many sessions.
Only apply idle/cost rules when per-skill attribution is reliable (recommended).
Move removed skills to .claude/skills-archived/ instead of deleting (requires skillArchival feature).
Do not auto-install high cost_estimate skills unless they already have recorded usage.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run sync-skills && npm run compile
scripts.pretest:integration: npm run sync-skills && npm run compile
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:marketplace && npm run package && npm run publish:openvsx
